0: AN ORDINANCE WEIGHT RESTRICTIONS OF VEHICLES ON CITY STREETS It shall be unlawful for the driver of any truck, wagon, or other commercial vehicle that exceeds 10,000 pounds GVW to use the following city streets: 1. Candy Cane Street 2. Dancer Street 3. December Street 4. Noel Street 5. Reindeer Street 6. Rudolph Street 7. Salem Street 8. Sleigh Street Unless the driver of such vehicles that are in excess of 10,000 pounds GVW shall have in the cab of the truck a bill of lading, work order or receipt for services for an address on a street subject to this restriction or on a street that must be accessed from the street subject to this restriction. Nothing in this ordinance shall be construed to prohibit trucks, wagons, or other commercial vehicles from crossing or using such streets as may be necessary to make delivery of articles, perform work or pick up goods from any point along the line of the street, provided that the driver of such vehicle shall have in the cab of the truck a bill of lading, work order, or receipt for services that bears the address or an address along the line of the street governed by this chapter. School buses, wreckers on call, and emergency vehicles plainly marked with emergency equipment are exempt from this ordinance.
